about_short_description.short_description: Dukhan Bank is Qatar's retail Bank provides savings accounts, current bank accounts.

product.name: Personal Banking Accounts
product.description: Sharia-compliant current, savings, time-deposit and home-business accounts for individuals and small home-based businesses in Qatar.

product.name: Personal Financing
product.description: Sharia-compliant financing for personal needs, including general personal finance and a dedicated option for eligible Qatari retirees.

product.name: Home Finance
product.description: Sharia-compliant property financing for purchasing, constructing or completing residential and other eligible real-estate properties.

product.name: Corporate Banking
product.description: Banking and financing solutions for businesses, institutions and government-related customers, including cash management, trade services and corporate cards.

product.name: Car Finance
product.description: Sharia-compliant vehicle financing for personal customers, including financing options for electric vehicles.

product.name: Dukhan Mobile
product.description: A mobile banking application for viewing accounts, opening additional accounts, managing cards, paying bills and transferring money.
